scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,frontend --prefix-colors auto "bun run --cwd apps/api dev" "bun run --cwd apps/frontend dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names api,frontend,sync --prefix-colors auto "bun run --cwd apps/api dev" "bun run --cwd apps/frontend dev" "bun run --cwd apps/sync-v2 dev"
scripts.lint:check: bun run --cwd apps/api lint && bun run --cwd apps/frontend lint
scripts.lint:safefix: bun run --cwd apps/api lint:fix && bun run --cwd apps/frontend lint:fix
scripts.format:check: bun run --cwd apps/api format:check && bun run --cwd apps/frontend format:check
scripts.format: bun run --cwd apps/api format && bun run --cwd apps/frontend format
